# A one-element attachment array keeps the single-record capacity

mimeEmitterEndHeader now declares attachments[1], resets the shared attIndex to zero, passes the array to GenerateAttachmentData and reads record zero on success. The earlier scalar plus address-of expression also held one record. The callee still indexes by attIndex++ and receives no capacity argument, so the new spelling is not a general bounds check or expanded buffer. Multi-attachment traversal is a separate caller with an n + 1 allocation. Keep the owned declaration change, later output-format gate changes and any suspected re-entry separate. This source study does not demonstrate a real overflow or a sanitizer-verified fix.

Scope: mailnews/MIME/header-completion.
